title: Wojtek the Soldier Bear

slides.title: THE BEAR WHO JOINED AN ARMY

slides.text: 1942, Iran. Polish soldiers, just released from Soviet prison camps, are travelling across the country to rejoin the fight in World War II.
On the road they meet a boy carrying a tiny brown bear cub. The soldiers trade him some food and a few coins for it.
The cub is too young to eat. The soldiers feed him condensed milk from an old bottle.
They name him Wojtek (say VOY-tek), meaning 'happy warrior'. He sleeps in their tents and follows them everywhere.
He grows into a full-size brown bear, taller than the men when he stands up, who acts like one of the company.

Then the army is ordered to sail to Italy. And animals are not allowed on the ships.
Part 2: how a bear became a soldier.

caption: In 1942, Polish soldiers in Iran adopted a tiny bear cub. He grew up in their tents, and he was about to go to war with them. Wojtek, part 1 of 3.
